$comment: Validated chart palettes for dashboards. Source of truth for src/lib/chart-palette.ts and the --viz-* tokens in src/styles/theme.css; scripts/check-palette.mjs validates both. Order is fixed: never cycle, never reorder by rank.

severity.darkBandWaiver: Dark orange and yellow sit above the dark lightness band (a red-orange-yellow ramp cannot separate inside it). Severity is ordinal and is never shown by colour alone: every severity mark carries its label or keeps its fixed order, and every chart has a table view.
